_README: These are the ENV VAR NAMES the config references as ${...}. Set them as environment variables / OS secret store on each machine BEFORE running the MCP servers. NEVER commit real values. This file documents what to set; copy to secrets.local.json (gitignored) only if you want a personal carry-file.
_claude_login: Claude auth is per-machine — run `/login`. Do NOT copy ~/.claude/.credentials.json.
HACKTRICKS_API_KEY: <hacktricks RAG key — ROTATE, it was exposed in chat; set: [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('HACKTRICKS_API_KEY','<v>','User')>
